title: Kling AI Officially Announces Its Debut at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival Market
excerpt: Artificial Intelligence (AI) company Keling has officially announced that it will make its debut at the TIFF Market from September 10 to 16, 2026, and will join
content_html:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) company Keling has officially announced that it will make its debut at the TIFF Market from September 10 to 16, 2026, and will join filmmakers, producers, and industry partners worldwide to explore how artificial intelligence can truly reach the cutting edge of film production.

As a key part of this major appearance, Keling AI will hold multiple in-depth exchange events during the exhibition. Among them, the industry forum is scheduled to take place from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM on September 10 at Stage B (Stage2) of the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, with the theme focusing on "New Paradigm of Creation: Keling AI Driving Coherent and Controllable Film-Level AI Video Creation."

Following this, an official industry networking reception will be held from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM on the same evening at the Founders’ Lounge on the second floor of TIFF Lightbox, inviting professionals to discuss the future trends of AI and film production. In addition, Keling AI's exclusive booth (Booth A20) will be open all day from September 10 to 16, looking forward to sharing with filmmakers around the world the present and future of AI empowering film creation.
